name: graph_reroute_tie
description: N-6: the wiring gets control points. Inside the definition body, an edge is given a reroute by double-clicking it, the node it lands on is dragged and the bend stays where it was put, the reroute and a second edge are tied into one bundle, the bundle is dragged, and the whole placement comes back out of a project the engine has re-read from disk.
